name: pp-devteam
description: A full AI development team for Power Platform projects. Seven specialized roles — Orchestrator, Business Analyst, Data Architect, UI Designer, App Builder, QA Tester, and ALM Engineer — delivered as both user-invocable skills and Task-invocable subagents. Collaborates across Canvas Apps, Power Pages, Model-Driven Apps, Code Apps, Dataverse, and Azure SQL. Also includes pp-live-meeting, a live-meeting facilitation skill that streams a real-time transcript into the team (requires the companion meeting MCP server).
